_doc: Swap alternatives for the rings (Eliran 2026-11-17: 3 per category ≈ $16). New pieces in the house's design line (oak, linen, bouclé, rattan, walnut, travertine) — generic descriptions, no brand or named design. Each: studio photo by nano-banana-pro/edit with the original piece's studio photo as the style reference, then Hunyuan 3D (scripts/16_item_3d.mjs alt mode).

sofa.size: about 260 cm wide, 95 cm deep, 75 cm high

items.desc: a gently curved three-seat sofa upholstered in thick ivory boucle (#ece6dc) with rounded continuous back and arms, sitting on a low recessed light-oak plinth
a straight three-seat sofa with deep box cushions in soft terracotta linen-velvet (#b4674a), slim tapered walnut legs, tight back
a deep lounge sofa with loose feather seat and back cushions in washed sage-green linen (#9aa088), relaxed slipcover with soft wrinkles, low profile

armchair.size: about 75 cm wide, 75 cm deep, 72 cm high

items.desc: a round barrel armchair fully upholstered in cream boucle (#eee8de), wraparound back, plump seat cushion, no visible legs
a low lounge chair with a solid light-oak frame and a cognac leather sling seat and back (#9a5a2e) held by leather straps
a low armchair of natural bent rattan with a curved woven back and a thick off-white linen seat cushion

dining_chair.size: about 50 cm wide, 52 cm deep, 80 cm high

items.desc: a light solid-oak dining chair with a curved woven cane backrest and an upholstered oatmeal linen seat
a light-oak dining chair with a curved bent-wood backrest and a seat of woven natural paper cord
a fully upholstered dining chair in ivory boucle with a rounded back that curves into the arms, short tapered oak legs

dining_table.size: about 180 cm long, 90 cm wide, 75 cm high

items.desc: a round 130 cm solid light-oak dining table on a thick fluted round pedestal
a rectangular dining table with a honed warm-beige travertine top and two thick travertine slab legs
a rectangular solid walnut dining table with softly rounded corners and four slender tapered legs
a round low drum coffee table carved from honed warm-beige travertine with visible pores
an oval low coffee table in solid walnut with a thick top and a recessed oval base
two round nesting coffee tables in light oak, one taller and smaller partly over the larger one, slim legs
a large round rice-paper lantern pendant shade with fine horizontal ribs
a wide drum pendant shade in oatmeal linen with a soft glow, slightly tapered
a dome pendant of smoked amber glass with a small brushed brass cap

bed.size: single bed 100 cm wide, 200 cm long, headboard 95 cm high

items.desc: a single bed in solid light oak with a slatted oak headboard, white and sand linen bedding
a single bed with a tall rounded headboard upholstered in sage linen, matching base, cream bedding
a single bed with an arched woven rattan headboard and a light oak frame, oatmeal linen bedding
a flat rectangular natural jute rug with a chunky braided weave
a rectangular hand-woven wool rug in cream with wide soft taupe stripes and short fringe
a round thick ivory wool boucle rug with a looped texture
